free_tier.stated: Free trials of 7 to 30 days depending on vendor: Alibaba 7 days (14 on some products), Tencent 15 days, Huawei 30 days, Baidu 7 days with a 180-day campaign variant, JD 15 days. Baidu's rules page requires a real-name verified account: "users who register and complete real-name verification".

retention.stated: Every one of the five gates the trial on real-name verification, which needs a national identity document, and every one ends within 30 days with no renewal path; the resource is auto-released at expiry.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing that survives a month. The only durable Chinese free lane is the 180-day Baidu campaign, and it is annual and date-boxed rather than recurring.

identity_cost.detail: registration plus real-name verification before any trial: Baidu's campaign rules require "users who register and complete real-name verification" and its 180-day event requires verification within a week of registration, and JD Cloud requires new-user status plus real-name verification; the comparison read adds Tencent requiring a corporate check or a personal credit score of at least 600 and Huawei requiring a bank card bound to the account. The record's own limits row reads that verification as needing a national identity document, which is why the kind is national-id; no evidence row quotes the document list, so whether a foreign passport can substitute is not stated. No hold amount is stated and debit or prepaid acceptance is not stated

evidence.proved: campaign rules require registration plus real-name verification, cap each user to one free claim per product class, and state that resources are released at expiry, quoted from the rules block
a 180-day trial event restricted to accounts registered on one day and real-name verified within a week, after which resources are cleaned up 7 to 30 days post-expiry

notes: This is one consolidated finding rather than five because the decision is the same and the door is the same: national identity. Two corrections worth carrying: JD's free period shrank from 6 months to 15 days, and Tencent's corporate requirement blocks an individual without a company. The 180-day Baidu figure is the largest in the group and still fails on identity. An account with a Chinese national ID would find a real 2 vCPU class trial here.
